version_notes: v3: od_02 endpoints moved onto the largest rowspacing-blocked forest patch (both endpoints verified passable at res14; A0 crosses the patch, A1a detours ~+248 m). v2 note: od_03/od_04/od_05 coordinates refined against orthophoto and vector boundaries to remove endpoint collisions with impassable water/buildings.

ods.name: Primary Baseline OD
ods.description: Baseline primary route OD traversing mixed farmland, road, and offroad terrain.

ods.name: Forest Rowspacing Boundary OD
ods.description: Straddles the largest dense-forest patch (rowspacing 1.7 m < vehicle width 2.056 m) so the rowspacing hard constraint forces a real detour.

ods.name: Water and Low-Lying Gully OD
ods.description: Crosses water bodies and low-lying drainage gullies to test water depth clearance and rain weather impedance. Goal positioned on passable gully margin.

ods.name: Road and Offroad Soil Interface OD
ods.description: Transitions between 3.0m/5.5m paved road network and offroad soil corridors to test road width and soil properties.

ods.name: Steep Slope Traverse OD
ods.description: Traverses steep terrain (approx 30 deg slope) to test pitch and roll angle decoupling on slope approach.
